### 1. Scene
A mixed meal of sliced chicken in a creamy sauce, penne pasta, and leafy salad with a cherry tomato and a few walnut pieces.

### 2. Vessel
A large, rounded-square dinner plate, partly cropped. I estimate an equivalent circular diameter of **26 cm**, giving an area of **3.14 × 13² ≈ 530 cm²**.

### 3–7. Items, area, volume, weight, and energy
Area shares below divide the visible food footprint without double-counting overlapping ingredients. The sauce appears to contain mushrooms and small grains or lentils; their identity is uncertain.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Cooked chicken slices | 30% | 159 × 1.4 = 223 ml | 0.95 | 211 g | 165 | 348 kcal |
| Cooked penne | 18% | 95 × 1.5 = 143 ml | 0.8 | 114 g | 155 | 177 kcal |
| Mixed leafy greens | 28% | 148 × 3 = 444 ml | 0.15 | 67 g | 25 | 17 kcal |
| Cherry tomato | 2% | 11 × 2 = 22 ml | 0.6 | 13 g | 18 | 2 kcal |
| Creamy mushroom/grain sauce | 7% | 37 × 1.2 = 44 ml | 1.0 | 44 g | 150 | 66 kcal |
| Walnut pieces | 1% | 5 × 0.8 = 4 ml | 0.6 | 3 g | 650 | 20 kcal |
| Oil/dressing sheen | Included above | Thin coating, approximately 5 ml | 0.92 | 5 g | 880 | 44 kcal |

**Coverage check:** 30 + 18 + 28 + 2 + 7 + 1 = **86%**, consistent with the mostly covered plate. Oil coats the food rather than occupying a separate footprint.

### 8. Sanity check
The estimate is **457 g and approximately 674 kcal**. A substantial chicken portion, a smaller pasta portion, and a bulky but light salad are plausible for what is visible. The biggest uncertainties are plate size and the richness of the sauce/dressing.
